title: Three-way merge strategy for user-edited deployed files
question: Implement a three-way merge (base = shipped vN, ours = live user-edited, theirs = shipped vN+1) with format-aware strategies: structural merge for JSON/TOML settings, line merge for markdown/scripts, and refuse-with-report for binary.

evidence.claim: Signal 1: merge output equals a hand-authored expected file for each of 7 fixture triples (7 passed). JSON structural, TOML structural, markdown line-diff3, binary refuse, and the reviewer key-reorder-plus-comment triple are included.

probes.raw_output:
PASS test_fixture_oracle
PASS test_json_structural_additive
PASS test_line_based_additive
PASS test_binary_refuse
PASS test_property_unique_ours_lines_survive
PASS test_negative_control_two_way_overwrite_fails_property (failures=176)
SUCCESS:IMP-0031 tests

evidence.claim: Signal 2: over 200 seeded random line triples, every line unique to ours survived in merge text or a conflict record (failures=0, with_unique=166). A two-way overwrite of the same triples failed the property (153 failures), so the test discriminates.

probes.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B command-center/p2-wave/seed-stage/g1_python.py -c 'from plugin.ours_invariant import run_property; from plugin.three_way_merge import merge_bytes; import json; print(json.dumps(run_property(merge_bytes)))'

probes.raw_output: SUCCESS:IMP-0031-probe2 property holds; overwrite control fires

negative_controls.description: A two-way overwrite (take theirs, drop ours, no conflict record) must FAIL the unique-ours-line property on the same 200 seeded triples the real merger passes. ; original-kind: known-broken-implementation

reviewer.notes: Adversarial triple: JSON key reorder of alpha/beta plus a leading // comment and a new timeout key on ours, gamma added on theirs. Structural merge kept the comment, timeout, and gamma without treating reorder as a conflict.

residual_unknowns.claim: JSON pretty-print commas are not a stable line identity: a user line '  "timeout": 30' can become '  "timeout": 30,' after a theirs-only key is appended. The unique-ours-line property is therefore enforced on the line-diff3 strategy, not on dumped JSON.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: If IMP-0024 needs byte-identical JSONC round-trips including trailing-comma placement, add a JSONC printer that preserves per-key original lines.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0033's on-disk provenance ledger is not present on this worktree. merge_with_provenance consumes an explicit record (base_bytes or base_path) rather than fetching git blobs.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Wire merge_with_provenance to the IMP-0033 ledger once that unit lands, and re-run probe2 against a live deploy snapshot.
